SYNTHETIC TEST SHOW - written for this repository's tests; not part of any input pack.
EPISODE NUMBER: Episode 3
EPISODE LOGLINE: Derek and Brenda mock Ethan as a nobody at the shareholders' night - until the board bows to him.
CONTINUITY NOTES: Follows directly from Episode 2. Ethan's identity is still hidden from Mia.

--- SCRIPT START ---

Start: (00:04.80) | End: (00:05.80)

**DEREK (Cruel):**
Start: (00:05.80) | End: (00:08.80)

**MIA (Angry):**
Start: (00:08.80) | End: (00:11.20)

**BRENDA (Taunting):**
Start: (00:11.20) | End: (00:14.00)

Start: (00:14.00) | End: (00:17.00)
Wide shot as the ballroom doors open and the entire board of directors enters in silence.

Start: (00:14.00) | End: (00:16.60)
The board members stop in front of Ethan and bow their heads.

Start: (00:16.60) | End: (00:19.20)

**MIA (Stunned):**
Start: (00:19.20) | End: (00:21.20)
"Mr. Vance?"

**MIA (Shocked, Breathless):**
Start: (00:21.20) | End: (00:23.60)
"You're the CEO?"

**ETHAN (Quiet, Firm):**
Start: (00:23.60) | End: (00:26.60)

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:26.60) | End: (00:28.60)

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:28.60) | End: (00:29.60)

**BRENDA (Panicked):**
Start: (00:29.60) | End: (00:31.80)
"That's impossible."

**ETHAN (Cold, Menacing):**
Start: (00:31.80) | End: (00:35.00)
"Derek, your company's loan is due tomorrow. I'm calling it in."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:35.00) | End: (00:38.00)
Close-up of Derek's face as the color drains from it.

**SOUND FX:**
Start: (00:35.00) | End: (00:36.40)

**DEREK (Desperate, Shouting):**
Start: (00:36.40) | End: (00:38.80)

**ETHAN (Tender):**
Start: (00:44.40) | End: (00:47.40)

**MIA (Warm):**
Start: (00:47.40) | End: (00:49.80)

**ETHAN (Gentle, Loving):**

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:52.40) | End: (00:55.40)
